name: Kings Ranch to Border Line
monitor_reason: uncorroborated: one source (EIA historical table), no independent confirmation the line still exists or is not an existing GEM row under another name; web search was unavailable (session limit) so no second source or current owner was found
researcher_notes: The EIA pipeline projects release for August 2026, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 157, lists Kings Ranch To Border Line. Sponsor Coral Energy Corp. New pipeline, completed 23 October 2000, Texas, intrastate under state jurisdiction, 102.5 miles, 24 inch, 300 MMcf/d. The next row (158) lists a 0.3 mile interstate Kings Ranch to Argulles border crossing, a Texas to Mexico expansion by the same company, FERC docket CP99-564. The URL checked out and contains the project name. No row in the 20261002 gas snapshot matches by name or by Coral Energy; no check was possible against pipes with other names near Kings Ranch, Texas. Owner today is unknown (Coral Energy became Shell Energy North America). Not staged as a new row until a second source or state regulator record confirms the line exists and who runs it. Staging values if later confirmed: LengthKnown 102.5 mi, Diameter 24 in, Capacity 300 MMcf/d, Status operating, ProposalYear 2000. Route not researched.
